staged_taint_guards.name: cached-empty-generated-string-taint
staged_taint_guards.evidence_scope: Staged internal guard evidence; not a full public compile or Agent outcome
setup_sequence: Admit one actual source request ledger for the exact supplied entry revision
Instantiate ConstructionCompiler with real linked source and ExecutionConstructionBudget
Register the original scene object and owned Family through ordinary _register_tree exactly as run() does
Call field("shape","copied",compiler.program); verify actual immutable String leaf. and one completed concat with five reserved bytes
Call _ensure_collection("shape.bad") on the same compiler and same admitted ledger
Capture original inherited guard refusal and verify established binding is not recomputed
forbidden_setup: Do not inject Value objects or taints
Do not mutate _shape_stack, collection state, clock, operation counters or reservation counters
Do not substitute a custom ledger decision or prebuilt diagnostic

guard_contract.message: Collection shape depends on a generated collection or another generated occurrence.
guard_contract.repair: Revise the indicated declaration or expression to satisfy the stated core rule.
guard_contract.reason_for_finite_alternatives: The ordinary prewarm collection read marks shape.family.leaves. The generated leaf member adds no separate mark outside an active shape; replay therefore has this one exact inherited taint.

aggregate_counter_setup: Only actual preceding operations on same admitted ledger; never preload reservations. Individual overflow must be detected before cumulative check. Allocation-stage exhaustion/cancellation precedes aggregate check.

static_abstract_requirement.known_String_payload_scope: Only the abstract String binary subexpression must be unknown. Actual completed source result remains its frozen expected value, including known "ok" for ignored-branch-no-allocation.

missing_context.message: This source profile requires its explicitly admitted execution context.

actual_deadline_exhaustion.scope: Real helper/current-ledger guard, separate from source/Agent cases
actual_deadline_exhaustion.observation: At the selected actual stage, an observing callback waits using ordinary real time until the unchanged ledger elapsed_ms exceeds its 1000 ms cap, then returns normally. The actual ledger tick must issue its original deadline refusal. Each wait is bounded to approximately one second.
actual_deadline_exhaustion.expected_consumed: Actual finite elapsed_ms strictly greater than 1000, never a substituted number
actual_deadline_exhaustion.expected_stage: Exactly the selected real String stage

reservation_expectations.publication: Full result bytes already reserved and not refunded
